primary_sources.finding: pg_get_constraintdef reconstructs constraint SQL from catalog state; it does not return the original command text.
BETWEEN first produces AEXPR_BETWEEN rather than BoolExpr, so a surrounding AND cannot flatten its yet-untransformed comparisons.
transformAExprBetween later creates an AND BoolExpr with >= and <= children. transformBoolExpr transforms and appends its arguments without flattening a transformed nested BoolExpr.
makeAndExpr immediately flattens an already present left-hand AND BoolExpr during grammar parsing.
Ordinary expression parentheses return the enclosed expression directly and do not introduce a wrapper that prevents AND flattening.
The non-pretty BoolExpr deparser emits separate parentheses around each stored AND node.
pg_dump obtains table CHECK SQL through pg_get_constraintdef rather than preserving the original BETWEEN spelling.

source_supported_inference: The immutable BETWEEN expression can store a nested AND created after grammar parsing. Deparse expands BETWEEN to comparisons. Reparse then sees that inner AND during grammar parsing and flattens it, yielding a different grouping and reconstructed parenthesis text under identical GUCs. This explanation is inferred from the pinned primary source and the public immutable migration; this research artifact does not execute or certify a restore.

bounded_repair_candidate.method: Recreate only the one known CHECK using its exact immutable original BETWEEN definition through supported DDL. Require the known relation, constraint, source/restore hash pair and matching remaining catalog state before the change. Accept only an exact post-reconstruction source definition and every existing strict catalog comparison.
